listing.description: Escape the hustle and bustle of city living and discover the charm of this inviting 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom cabin retreat, tucked among beautiful trees and surrounded by lush greenery. With thoughtful upgrades throughout, this cozy getaway blends rustic charm with modern improvements, making it an ideal choice for a weekend escape, full-time living, or your own peaceful mountain hideaway. Enjoy the fresh air and natural surroundings from the front and back decks, featuring a new deck extension in the back that provides even more space to relax, entertain, or enjoy your morning coffee. Take in the scenic mountain views, unwind in the tranquil garden, and listen to the soothing sounds of the seasonal stream flowing just behind the property, accompanied by the peaceful songs of local birds, Steller s Jay and Mountain Chickadee. Step inside and discover a welcoming, open-concept living space that seamlessly connects the living room, kitchen, and dining area. The pellet stove adds warmth and cozy cabin ambiance during cooler months, creating the perfect setting for relaxing evenings after a day spent enjoying the outdoors. Designed for convenient, single-level living, this home offers two comfortable bedrooms with room for you and your guests to unwind. The primary bedroom features a spacious walk-in closet. The recently remodeled bathroom showcases a brand-new shower, adding a fresh, updated touch to the home. Additional improvements include a new water heater for added peace of mind. For added security, bear-resistant security bars have been installed on the back windows, along with a bear-resistant front-door screen, offering practical upgrades for mountain living. Outside, a newer enclosed storage shed provides convenient space for gardening tools, outdoor equipment, and seasonal essentials. Whether you're looking for a quiet weekend escape, a cozy full-time residence, or a peaceful place to reconnect with nature, this charming cabin offers a wonderful combination of comfort, privacy, and thoughtful updates. Enjoy the slower pace of life, breathe in the fresh mountain air, and make this inviting retreat your own! The HOA amenities are pickleball, tennis, pool, spa, 9-hole golf course, fishing, clubhouse, biking and hiking trails along with security!

verdict: A genuinely charming, dirt-cheap, fully furnished forest cabin with real deck-level ridge views, a covered gazebo sit spot, and verified resort-HOA amenities — that happens to sit 6h 09m from SF, more than double the buyer's hard 3-hour gate. Everything the getaway brief wants (turnkey STR styling, privacy, stream, $260k price) is present except proximity. As an SF weekend escape it fails the gate decisively; as a cheap mountain STR/cabin asset it is strong for an LA-based buyer (PMC is ~1.5–2h from LA). The 3.2 score is almost entirely drive-time drag.
